sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Double-Shot PBT Plastic Injection of Novelty Keyboard Keycaps

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu – International Companies regime administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law and French civil law heritage; codified offshore company statute; custom law recognized under Constitution)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Limited TIEA network (e.g., concluded with Australia, New Zealand and Nordic jurisdictions); no comprehensive DTAAs in force

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 14 of 2011 (as amended by Act No. 28 of 2014 and Act No. 1 of 2018); International Companies Act [Cap. 222], ss. 14, 39 and 86 (amended 2009-2013, abolition of bearer shares and mandatory agent-held registers); Companies and Limited Partnerships (Economic Substance) Act No. 20 of 2019 and Regulations 2019; VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook and Compliance Guidelines; FATF/APG Mutual Evaluation framework.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (no public UBO registry; beneficial ownership register maintained by licensed Registered Agent and accessible to VFSC, Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit and competent authorities on lawful request; nominee arrangements must be disclosed to the agent)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each director and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority or commissioning notary public in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; notarization followed by attestation of the competent authority in the origin country and legalization by a Vanuatu diplomatic/consular post, or via the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs where no consulate exists)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, issued within 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Public utility provider or licensed bank in country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (same chain as above; apostilles are not recognized in Vanuatu)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter covering account conduct and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing licensed bank, signed by a senior bank official
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (notarized signature then consular attestation)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Incumbency or registry extract (for any corporate shareholder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry or licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (certified registry copy authenticated by competent authority and Vanuatu consulate)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors and officers against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List (Res. 1267/1373 regime), OFAC SDN List, UK HMT sanctions, and VFSC regulatory warnings; PEP definition and EDD requirements applied per AML/CFT Act s. 2 and FATF Recommendations 12 and 22; automated database screening at onboarding plus ongoing transaction and registry monitoring; commercial risk tier for ISIC 3240 / NAICS 334118 keyboard keycap manufacturing classified as Low_Risk_Standard.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission – Companies Registry (International Companies section); name search and reservation e-service available via www.vfsc.vu; applications must be lodged electronically through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be in Roman/Latin script and English; non-Roman character sets (including Chinese characters) and transliterations are not accepted; the name must end with an authorized limited-liability suffix: Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, Inc, or Société Anonyme.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the Registered Agent may immediately file a fresh application with up to two alternative names; a written reconsideration request must be submitted to the Registrar of International Companies at VFSC within 14 days of refusal; further administrative review is available through VFSC; ultimate recourse is an application for judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu under the Court Procedure Rules 2018 (Part 12).

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible in substance: an International Company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the office of its VFSC-licensed Registered Agent, but the physical business of PBT plastic injection, warehousing and e-commerce may be conducted wholly outside Vanuatu with no local employees or premises; management and control must remain outside Vanuatu to preserve non-resident tax status; annual Economic Substance Act filings and non-residence declarations must be submitted through the Registered Agent.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated under 5% annual probability for a low-risk retail manufacturing IC); supervisory inspections, including unannounced visits, are directed primarily at the Registered Agent's CDD records rather than the IC itself; direct inspection of the IC's premises may occur only upon tax-residency indicators, AML/CFT suspicion, or court order.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name search and reservation (government fee, per name)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Act [Cap. 223], Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation and first-year annual registration/license fee (authorized capital up to US$50,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Act [Cap. 223], Schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed Registered Agent and registered office service (year one, mandatory under International Companies Act s. 39)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark range US$400-650 per annum

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT client onboarding, UBO verification, risk assessment and compliance file preparation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark reflecting mandatory CDD obligations under the AML/CFT Act 2011

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization of UBO, address and bank reference document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public in country of origin and Vanuatu consulate / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate per document set; consular route required because Vanuatu is not an Apostille Convention party

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Good Standing or Certificate of Incumbency (one-time initial issuance)
Economic Substance annual return and non-residence declaration preparation (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered Agent / local compliance service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark under Companies and Limited Partnerships (Economic Substance) Act No. 20 of 2019

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Optional same-day / fast-track incorporation processing premium
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Discretionary service add-on at prevailing market rate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1993 (Cap 222), sections 4-12 (incorporation), 15 (registered office), 17 (registered agent), 25 (directors), 44 (corporate capacity and powers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registrar of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 — Application for Registration as an International Company, submitted with the Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; the International Company may be incorporated with nil issued shares and no escrow deposit is required. The authorised capital (commonly USD 50,000 divided into USD 1.00 shares) is declared in the Memorandum without any obligation to pay up.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers' share subscription be and is hereby approved and the allotment of one (1) ordinary share of USD 1.00 each to the founding subscriber effective as of the date of incorporation be ratified. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be established at [Registered Office Address], Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu, pursuant to section 15 of the International Companies Act, and that the VFSC-licensed registered agent be retained. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name], [Name] and [Name] be and are hereby appointed as the first directors of the Company. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the corporate secretary appointment be confirmed. RESOLVED FURTHER, that officers execute all documents and pay all fees to perfect the incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name clearance and pre-incorporation availability search
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry via a VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the registered agent to submit a name reservation request to the VFSC Registry. The agent performs a search against the registers of International Companies and domestic companies. Upon preliminary clearance, the chosen name is reserved for up to 30 days pending filing of the incorporation application.
required_dossiers: Notarized passport copy of the founding shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as confusingly similar, prohibited, or inconsistent with the Act, submit up to three alternative names for re-clearance, or appeal the refusal to the VFSC Registrar within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, execution, and notarization of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent and Vanuatu notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English in compliance with the International Companies Act. Have the subscriber execute these documents and arrange notarization of signatures plus certification of passport copies. Deliver the original notarized documents, together with executed consent forms, to the registered agent for filing.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Director forms for each proposed director
Consent to Act as Registered Agent form
Notarized passport copies of subscribers and directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VFSC queries defective constitutional documents, rectify the stated deficiencies and re-file the corrected documents within 7 business days; no additional penalty is imposed if the cure is completed within the prescribed period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, VFSC, Port Vila (over-the-counter or digital lodgment through the licensed agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the executed Memorandum and Articles, director consents, registered office particulars, and registered agent consent. Pay the prescribed state filing fee of USD 350 by bank transfer to the VFSC account and obtain a dated submission acknowledgment from the Registry.
required_dossiers: Registered Office and Registered Agent consents
Proof of payment of the USD 350 filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for incompleteness, resubmit the specified missing documents within 7 days. If the application is rejected on legal grounds, correct the defect and file a fresh application with an explanatory cover letter to the Registry.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and preparation of statutory registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon VFSC approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent then prepares the statutory registers (shareholders, directors, significant controllers, and charges), the corporate minute book, share certificates, and the common seal. The certificate date is treated as the company's incorporation date.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate of Incorporation contains errors in the company name, number, or date, submit a rectification request to the VFSC with supporting documentation; a corrected certificate is issued within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Confirmation of registered office and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Registry and VFSC-licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Verify that the registered office is physically located in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and that a licensed registered agent is retained. File any change of registered office or registered agent with the VFSC within 30 days. Confirm that the agent will maintain custody of statutory records and receive official correspondence.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent resigns or its license is revoked, appoint a successor licensed agent within 21 days and file the notice of change with the VFSC to avoid deregistration of the company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation governance and tax-exempt status confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors; VFSC; Vanuatu Tax Office under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting to adopt the share subscription, approve the registered office, and confirm the appointment of officers as recorded in the First Board Resolution. Issue subscribed share certificates and open the statutory registers. Obtain from the VFSC the standard tax exemption acknowledgment confirming the International Company is exempt from income tax, stamp duty, and capital gains tax under the International Companies Act.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the First Board Meeting
Tax exemption certificate or acknowledgment letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax exemption acknowledgment is not automatically provided, file a written application with the Vanuatu Tax Office for a specific exemption ruling; any adverse assessment may be appealed to the Minister of Finance within 30 days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Cooperatives of Vanuatu, together with the Port Vila Municipal Council for local business licensing
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Vanuatu Business Licence (Category: Manufacturing / Processing) issued under the Business Licence Act [Cap 276]

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Environment, Energy and Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B — Preliminary Environmental Assessment (PEA) for a small-scale plastic injection moulding facility with installed capacity below 500 kW and resin throughput below 1 tonne per day; a full Environmental Impact Assessment report is not required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Vanuatu National Pollution Control standards apply: wastewater pH 6.0-9.0, BOD not exceeding 30 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L prior to discharge to municipal sewer; VOC and particulate emissions controlled by local exhaust ventilation to meet ambient workplace thresholds; plastic scrap, sprues, and defective keycaps must be segregated and disposed of through a DEPC-approved licensed waste carrier with manifests retained for at least 3 years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Police Fire and Rescue Service; structural occupancy inspection by the Department of Public Works; workplace health and safety registration with the Department of Labour under the Health and Safety at Work Act; electrical installation compliance certificate and mechanical guarding approval for injection moulding presses.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management; corporate licensing and registration of the International Company (IC) is administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC). Primary portals: https://vcir.gov.vu (tax and customs) and https://www.vfsc.vu (IC corporate e-Registry and annual returns).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company is a non-resident, tax-exempt legal person; no national income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, or withholding tax TIN is issued or required. Where a VAT identity is needed for voluntary registration, the IC files Form VAT-01 with the VCIR attaching the VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, constitutional documents, director identification, registered-agent confirmation, and turnover projections. Compulsory VAT registration applies when taxable turnover in any 12-month period equals or exceeds VT 5,000,000. For customs purposes, the IC registers as a trader in the ASYCUDA World portal to obtain a Customs Client ID for export declarations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: The Vanuatu International Company is statutorily exempt from income tax, VAT on offshore operations, capital gains tax, stamp duty, and inheritance tax under the International Companies Act 1992; it is prohibited from carrying on business with Vanuatu residents and from owning Vanuatu real property, so its offshore custom-manufacturing and export of keyboard keycaps falls entirely outside the Vanuatu VAT and income tax net.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box, fiscal unity, or hybrid-mismatch election exists in Vanuatu. The IC may voluntarily apply for VAT registration even when below the compulsory threshold, which permits input VAT recovery on locally purchased materials, while exported goods remain zero-rated. An IC may elect to convert to a domestic company under the Companies Act 1991, thereby forfeiting its tax-exempt status, but this election is commercially inadvisable and rarely used.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) pursuant to the Value Added Tax Act No. 29 of 1998, as amended, administered by VCIR
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (Vatu) annual taxable turnover for compulsory registration; voluntary registration available at VCIR discretion
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No national e-invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API stamping, or CTC (continuous transaction control) mandate exists. Export consignments must be cleared electronically through ASYCUDA World, which is mandatory for all export declarations. Printed or PDF VAT invoices used for domestic supplies must meet minimum content requirements under the VAT Act; no digital fiscal stamping applies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods physically exported from Vanuatu within 28 days of supply, and to services supplied to a non-resident recipient where the direct benefit is enjoyed wholly outside Vanuatu. Custom double-shot PBT keycaps manufactured in Vanuatu and sold to offshore buyers via Shopify Payments or Stripe qualify for 0% VAT, provided the IC retains proof of export and non-resident status of the purchaser; goods supplied while the IC remains non-resident and goods never entering Vanuatu are outside the scope of VAT entirely.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration processed electronically in ASYCUDA World
Bill of Lading or House Airway Bill evidencing physical removal of goods from Vanuatu
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 / bank credit advice evidencing foreign-currency receipt of consideration
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Vanuatu imposes no exchange-control regime and no statutory FX repatriation deadline; exporters generally document payment within 180 days as a prudential benchmark for zero-rating substantiation. VCIR may audit zero-rating claims retrospectively and any erroneous or fraudulent claim triggers repayment of VAT, statutory late-payment penalties and interest, and criminal fines plus imprisonment for knowingly false declarations under the VAT Act; directors of the IC remain personally liable for fraudulent customs documentation, and the tax-exempt status of the IC does not shield against prosecution for customs or VAT fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), the statutory central bank constituted under the Central Bank Act, holds exclusive authority over monetary policy, vatu (VUV) issuance and convertibility, administration of exchange-control rules, and licensing/oversight of authorized-dealer banks. The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) acts as the corporate registry and AML/CFT supervisor for International Companies. The RBV operates the domestic payments and settlement infrastructure and jointly administers the policy framework applicable to the Vanuatu International Company (VU_IC) with the VFSC.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu observes IMF Article VIII obligations: the vatu is freely convertible for current-account and capital-account payments, with no prior approval required for trade-related FX conversion, dividend repatriation, or capital injections by an International Company. The current account is fully open for the keyboard-caps exporter: sales proceeds remitted by payment aggregators (Stripe, Shopify Payments) may be credited to VUV or foreign-currency accounts and converted at market rates. The capital account is equally open for an IC: share capital, shareholder loans, and intercompany transfers may enter and leave without RBV consent, and there are no profit-remittance hurdles other than standard AML/KYC documentation (source-of-funds certificates, underlying sales/supply contracts, CRS/FATCA self-certifications). The only practical convertibility friction is the thinness of the offshore VUV market; USD is the effective settlement currency.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None applicable to the VU_IC. The International Companies Act legislatively exempts International Companies from the exchange-control regime, meaning there is no statutory timeline, no minimum conversion ratio, and no forced sale of export proceeds to the RBV or an authorized dealer. Export receipts from custom mechanical keyboard keycap sales, including aggregated Stripe and Shopify Payouts in USD, AUD, and EUR, may be retained, swept, netted, or hedged at the IC's discretion. Administrative expectation: maintain a six-year trail of export invoices, logistics documents, and payout reconciliation reports for the bank's AML file and for any future economic-substance or tax-residency examination.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account plus USD Foreign-Currency Settlement Account
Operational Account with Multi-Currency (VUV/USD/AUD) Treasury Facilities
Operational Account and Trade Finance (Commercial LC) Facilities
Capital Escrow and VUV Operational Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. A Vanuatu IC will almost certainly be declined by mainstream offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Payoneer, Mercury, Airwallex, Relay) because Vanuatu triggers higher-risk jurisdiction filters, non-resident beneficial-ownership flags, and correspondent-bank de-risking policies; in addition, no offshore EMI clears VUV. The commercially viable architecture is a layered one: use a U.S., Singapore, or U.K. merchant subsidiary to onboard Shopify Payments and Stripe, receive settlement funds there, and then make documented intercompany payments (loans or purchases) to the VU_IC for manufacturing procurement and margin retention under a transfer-pricing memorandum.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote fully digital account opening is not available in practice for first-time International Companies at ANZ or Bred: both insist on an in-person KYC interview at a Port Vila branch for at least one director or the ultimate beneficial owner, held together with the licensed VFSC registered agent. BSP and NBV permit a hybrid remote opening (notarized or apostilled corporate documents, video interview, and signed original board resolutions couriered to the branch) subject to enhanced due diligence. The VU_IC is advised to appoint one local director or a professional nominee director with VFSC agent credentials to satisfy the physical-presence mandate without delay.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Jurisdiction source-of-wealth concern: the Vanuatu IC is tax-exempt and Vanuatu has historically appeared on periodic FATF and EU AML/CFT watch-listing reviews, causing banks to flag unexplained wealth and pass-through transactions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC; registered-agent certificate and due-diligence letter; full UBO declaration on the VFSC AML form; audited or management accounts of the parent and beneficial owner; 12 months of source-of-funds bank statements; published product catalogue, manufacturing-site photographs, and supplier invoices for PBT resin and molds.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Business-scope mismatch: ISIC 3240 (manufacture of games and toys) and NAICS 334118 (computer terminal and other computer peripheral equipment manufacturing) for niche novelty keyboard keycaps sit outside the bank's standard merchant trade matrix, triggering ambiguous business-description reviews.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: ISIC/NAICS mapping letter prepared by the compliance advisor; e-commerce storefront URLs (Shopify, Amazon) and live listings; Stripe and Shopify Payout settlement histories; injection-molding supplier contracts; bill-of-lading and courier waybills evidencing physical product flow and a genuine manufacturing supply chain.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payment aggregation: Stripe and Shopify Pay settlements and marketplace chargebacks obscure the underlying trade line and are commonly red-flagged under money-laundering typologies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed payment-facilitator agreements; bank statements showing aggregated payouts; chargeback and refund ledgers; order-level reconciliation report mapping order ID, SKU, unit price, and customer jurisdiction; customer correspondence and logistics-provider contracts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt IC substance deficiency: a zero-tax offshore company with non-resident directors is interpreted as tax-evasion or sanctions-evasion risk by correspondent banks and may be declined or subjected to excessive due diligence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Economic-substance and business-purpose memorandum; lease agreement evidencing the Vanuatu administrative office; payroll and employment records if staff are engaged in-country; board-meeting minutes held by directors; CRS/FATCA tax self-certifications filed with the bank; confirmation from the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit that no adverse AML enforcement action is outstanding.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Remit via SWIFT MT103 only, from the beneficial owner's or parent company's bank into the IC's operational USD or VUV account at ANZ or Bred, with the remittance narrative stating 'capital contribution / shareholder loan - International Companies Act' and no ambiguous third-party intermediaries. The receiving bank will require a board resolution authorizing the injection, the VFSC register extract showing the shareholder, a source-of-wealth certificate, and CRS/FATCA self-certification. No RBV exchange-control approval is needed. For VUV-denominated legs the funds clear through the RBV-operated payments system; for USD legs they clear through the New York or Sydney correspondent network. Confirm the value date before issuing supplier purchase orders.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Two clearing rails are recommended: (1) direct SWIFT MT103 transfers for PBT resin, molds, packaging, and Asian supplier invoices, each tied to a commercial invoice and packing list; and (2) irrevocable sight or standby commercial letters of credit issued through ANZ or BSP for large production batches. Digitally delivered keycap designs (STL and 3D-print files) are invoiced as services and cleared by MT103 against a service agreement. Every disbursement must be accompanied by the complete export pack comprising the commercial invoice, packing list, airway bill or bill of lading, and, where relevant, certificate of origin, to avoid sanctions-screening holds. For USD payouts the bank routes via New York correspondents and applies OFAC screening, so beneficiary names must be strictly verified against sanctions lists.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright deliverable VUV/USD forward contracts with authorized dealers (ANZ, Bred) for up to 12-month tenors
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts referencing USD/VUV booked with offshore banks in Sydney or Singapore, given the limited depth of the onshore deliverable VUV market
Cross-currency swaps (USD/VUV) with international banking relationships for longer-dated capital exposures
Plain-vanilla FX options for the purchase of USD against VUV, covered by underlying purchase orders and customer receivables
Natural hedging through multi-currency accounts (USD, AUD, EUR) and FX netting across the IC's Stripe and Shopify settlement currencies

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Registrar of International Companies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the anniversary of the date of incorporation each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 50 per month or part of a month; persistent non-compliance for 3 months or more gives the Registrar power to strike the company off the International Companies Register

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Not applicable — Vanuatu International Companies are tax-exempt and are statutorily exempt from mandatory independent audit regardless of turnover, assets, or number of shareholders
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory accounting framework is prescribed; voluntary financial statements may be prepared under IFRS or other recognized GAAP where required by directors, lenders, or counterparties

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO declaration filing is required for International Companies; however, the registered agent is obliged to maintain a current beneficial ownership register and any share transfer or change of controllers must be recorded immediately upon notification. Annual confirmation is implicit in the annual return filing and is reflected by the agent's attestation of unchanged or updated ownership records.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – 1,200 per annum depending on the registered agent and inclusion of compliance support services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable; voluntary audit by a VFSC-licensed practice typically ranges USD 1,500 – 4,000 per engagement

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Nil) — Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax; an International Company (IC) is contractually and statutorily exempt from all Vanuatu national taxes under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full statutory exemption from corporate income tax, capital gains tax, personal income tax, withholding tax, stamp duty on offshore transactions, and exchange control. VAT at 12.5% applies only to domestic Vanuatu consumption; qualifying offshore trading by an IC is zero-rated. The only annual impost is the fixed VFSC government fee of approximately USD 300 (approx. VUV 35,000).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No domestic CIT return exists for an exempt International Company. The operative fiscal compliance filing is the VFSC Annual Renewal Record (annual confirmation plus payment of the fixed government fee), submitted electronically by the licensed Vanuatu registered agent through the VFSC Online e-Filing Portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Anniversary-based: the Annual Renewal Record and fee are due on each anniversary of the Certificate of Incorporation. A 30-day administrative grace period is applied by the VFSC; thereafter a 10% flat late-payment surcharge accrues, and continued default for three months triggers strike-off proceedings.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1 — Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name exactly matching the Certificate of Incorporation, including the required suffix 'Limited', and the unique VU company number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Verify spelling with the registered agent; any name change requires a directors' special resolution and VFSC approval before filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical Vanuatu address maintained for service of process, typically the registered agent's office; a post office box is not acceptable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders cannot substitute a foreign address; the registered office must remain continuously available to the VFSC and to process servers.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and licence number of the VFSC-licensed agent in Vanuatu who lodges the record and holds the IC's statutory records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must be appointed by the directors; foreign entities, corporate service providers outside Vanuatu, or the beneficial owners themselves cannot act as agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Narrative of actual commercial activity: 'Cross-border e-commerce and wholesale trade in custom mechanical keyboard keycaps (ISIC 3240 / NAICS 334118)'. This field determines ESR scope.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Describe the true activity accurately; declaring a Vanuatu distribution and service centre attracts Economic Substance Act reporting; declaring a passive offshore holding may invite anti-shell scrutiny from the VFSC and foreign tax authorities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that the register of members and the beneficial ownership register are physically maintained at the registered office, naming every 25% or greater shareholder, director, and ultimate beneficial owner.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Vanuatu beneficial-ownership legislation requires updates within 30 days of any change; non-resident UBOs must provide current passport, proof of residential address, and source-of-funds documentation to the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent's certification that customer due diligence has been completed on all directors, shareholders, and UBOs and that no sanctioned person (UN, OFAC, EU, UK) is involved.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expect refreshed KYC documentation (identity, address, corporate structure chart, source of funds) before each annual renewal cycle; refusal to provide current documentation prevents filing.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Fixed annual fee of approximately USD 300 (equivalent VUV 35,000), payable to the Government of Vanuatu through the VFSC; no income, profit, or turnover calculation is required.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fees are payable in VUV; the registered agent typically invoices the fee together with professional fees in USD or VUV; late payment attracts a 10% surcharge.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing or non-payment: 10% flat surcharge on the annual government fee; three months' default: Registrar publishes a strike-off notice; six months' default: automatic dissolution of the IC. Trading while struck off: each director becomes personally liable for all debts contracted after the strike-off date; reinstatement is discretionary and requires arrears, surcharges, and restoration costs of approximately VUV 50,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu has no dividend withholding tax, no general withholding-tax statute, and no taxation of distributions paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders; dividends from the IC are repatriated free of any Vanuatu deduction or levy.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No DTA relief is available: Vanuatu has no comprehensive double-tax agreement network and only limited Tax Information Exchange Agreements (e.g., with Australia and New Zealand) that confer no rate reductions. To evidence exemption for foreign tax-credit or bank purposes, the registered agent obtains a VFSC-issued Certificate of Tax Exemption reciting the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] exemption; this certificate functions as the practical equivalent of a tax-residence certificate. There is no TRC application procedure because Vanuatu has no income-tax administration.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory WHT: 0% on outbound royalties, interest, management fees, and service fees — Vanuatu imposes no deduction at source on such payments. Treaty rate: not applicable (no DTA). Caution: the jurisdiction of the payor or the recipient's home jurisdiction may impose its own withholding on payments sourced through or from the IC, which Vanuatu cannot mitigate by treaty.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and has not enacted Local File, Master File, or country-by-country reporting obligations applicable to International Companies. Defensive benchmark: prepare contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation whenever annual intercompany transactions (purchases, royalties, service fees) exceed VUV 10,000,000 (approx. USD 85,000), in order to withstand foreign CFC, GAAR, and substance challenges.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: Comparable Uncontrolled Price (CUP) for wholesale keycap catalogue pricing
Resale Price Method for distribution margin analysis
Cost Plus Method for injection-moulding subcontracting to related manufacturers
Transactional Net Margin Method (TNMM) applying a Berry ratio for e-commerce resellers
Profit Split Method for joint product design and trademark commercialisation
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Vanuatu Economic Substance (Implementation) Act 2021 applies to every Vanuatu-registered entity, including ICs, carrying on a 'relevant activity'. Cross-border e-commerce sale of keyboard keycaps constitutes a distribution and service centre. The IC must be directed and managed in Vanuatu, perform core income-generating activities in Vanuatu, maintain adequate premises and full-time employees in Vanuatu, and file an annual ESR return with the VFSC. A letterbox IC with only a registered agent fails the test; non-compliance exposes the IC to civil penalties, cancellation of registration, and criminal referral of directors.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An IC with no real Vanuatu operations charges and collects the 12.5% Vanuatu VAT from domestic customers without registration, knowingly zero-rates local sales, or creates fictitious input-credit invoices from related parties to obtain VAT refunds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: VAT Act No. 40 of 1998: civil penalty up to 200% of the tax evaded, plus late-payment penalties of up to 20% of the tax; criminal conviction: fines up to VUV 2,000,000 (approx. USD 17,000) and/or up to two years' imprisonment per count; the VFSC concurrently cancels the IC's registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false VAT returns or direct the evasion are jointly and severally liable for civil penalties; the corporate veil is pierced upon fraud; directors may be made subject to asset-freeze orders and prohibited from leaving Vanuatu pending criminal trial; extradition is available under the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC as a pure letterbox — no Vanuatu office, no employees, no board meetings in Vanuatu — while routing worldwide custom-keycap profits through the tax-exempt IC, and failing to file the mandatory annual ESR return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance (Implementation) Act 2021: civil penalty up to VUV 10,000,000 (approx. USD 84,000) per failure, with continuing penalties for ongoing default; VFSC strike-off and disqualification of the registered agent; referral to the OECD Global Forum may blacklist the structure and trigger international exchange of information.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly misstate substance face criminal liability with imprisonment up to two years; after strike-off, directors remain personally liable for obligations contracted subsequent to dissolution; foreign tax authorities may pierce the IC under CFC or GAAR rules and assess the beneficial owners at home-country rates with interest and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing Shopify Payments or Stripe revenue from sanctioned persons or jurisdictions, accepting unexplained bulk payments for 'wholesale' keycap shipments, or wilfully failing to update the beneficial ownership register after a UBO change; failure to conduct KYC on foreign wholesale counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2017 and the Proceeds of Crime Act [Cap. 280]: fines up to VUV 10,000,000 (approx. USD 84,000) for record-keeping and suspicious transaction reporting failures; money-laundering offences carry custodial sentences of up to 20 years; the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit may freeze all bank and payment-rail accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors and beneficial owners face criminal prosecution; personal assets may be frozen and travel bans imposed pending investigation; directors who sign false UBO declarations are personally liable to creditors and to the registered agent for resulting damages, and may be disqualified from managing any Vanuatu company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Misrepresentation to VFSC / False Annual Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing a false Annual Renewal Record — for example, declaring 'no activity' to avoid ESR while actively trading online, supplying a fictitious registered office address, or concealing a disqualified director or sanctioned UBO.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: International Companies Act [Cap. 222]: offence punishable by fines up to VUV 500,000 (approx. USD 4,200) and cancellation of the certificate of incorporation; reinstatement, if granted, requires court approval, payment of all arrears, and restoration fees of approximately VUV 100,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers who knowingly or recklessly provide false statements are personally criminally liable; VFSC may seek civil penalties and disqualification orders barring management of any Vanuatu company for up to 10 years; upon strike-off the Registrar may obtain a receivership over the IC's worldwide receivables.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Continued Trading After Strike-off / Unpaid Annual Fees
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to pay the annual government fee for three to six months and continuing to operate the e-commerce store, supplier contracts, and bank accounts after the Registrar has published the strike-off notice.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Automatic dissolution of the IC; all contracts entered into post-dissolution are voidable by counterparties; unpaid government fees, surcharges, and penalties remain due as a Crown debt enforceable in the Vanuatu courts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Every director is jointly and severally personally liable for debts and liabilities contracted while the company was struck off; shareholders lose limited-liability protection; counterparties may sue directors personally in Vanuatu and enforce foreign judgments against them; the Registrar may obtain asset-preservation orders, including travel restrictions, until the debt is satisfied.
